welcomeStep3Title.description: Title of step 3 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Right-click any tab, click the toolbar icon, or press Alt+Shift+P.
welcomeStep3Body.description: Body of step 3 on the welcome page.

welcomeNote.message: "Open in Private Window" opens a new private window with the same address — Firefox does not support private "tabs" inside a normal window. Your original tab stays open and unaffected.
welcomeNote.description: Closing note on the welcome page.

aboutHeading.description: Heading of the 'about' section on the welcome page.

aboutBody.message: Open in Private Window is a small, focused Firefox extension: it reopens the current tab's address in a new Private Browsing window, with optional tracking-parameter cleanup and an option to close the original tab. It makes no network requests and collects no data - all settings stay on your device.
